plainText:
This is a list of themes that have played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series. All movie endings were left in English.

==Openings==
As the first four seasons of the animated series were produced as a , their openings were voiced-over as well. The first opening is featured subtitled on Netflix. Starting from The Journey Starts Today, the openings started to be actually dubbed. None of the movie openings were ever voiced-over or dubbed,
and Always Safe was only shown with subtitles in Secrets of the Jungle.
